T: The park is open. So is the kitchen.
D: A fully working dinosaur theme park opens on Isla Nublar, and its newest creation escapes.
P: Serve the snacks when the mosasaur leaps up to grab its lunch.
S: the mosasaur grabbing the shark at feeding time
Big prawns grilled with garlic, chilli and lime, piled high on a platter with lime wedges for the crowd.
the gyrosphere ride through the valley
Cheddar, cream cheese and chives rolled into balls, coated in crushed nuts and paprika, with crackers.
the busy theme park main street
Soft pretzels boiled in bicarb water, brushed with butter and cinnamon sugar, baked at 220C for 12 minutes.
M: Owen at his bungalow by the lake
Beef ribs rubbed with paprika, pepper and salt, cooked at 140C for 5 hours, glazed with barbecue sauce, with corn and slaw.
the tropical island off Costa Rica
White fish dusted in chilli and cumin, pan-fried, in corn tortillas with cabbage, pineapple salsa and lime crema.
W: the dinosaur eggs in the hatchery
Chocolate mousse set in glasses, topped with a speckled white chocolate egg and crushed chocolate biscuit dirt.
K: the hot day at the park
Lemon juice, sugar and water frozen and blitzed into slush, poured into big cups with straws.

s.note: the mosasaur grabbing the shark at feeding time
s.how: Toss 600g green prawns with crushed garlic, chopped red chilli, lime zest and melted butter. Grill for 2 minutes a side until charred. Pile high on a platter with lime wedges, ready for the crowd at feeding time.

s.note: the gyrosphere ride through the valley
s.how: Mix 200g grated cheddar, 250g cream cheese and snipped chives. Roll into small balls and coat in finely chopped walnuts mixed with smoked paprika. Chill for an hour until firm. Serve with water crackers and stay inside the sphere.

m.note: the tropical island off Costa Rica
m.how: Dust 600g flathead in chilli, cumin and salt and pan-fry until just cooked. Dice half a pineapple with a little red onion and lime for salsa. Mix sour cream with lime for a crema. Fill corn tortillas with cabbage, fish, salsa and crema.

w.note: the dinosaur eggs in the hatchery
w.how: Melt 200g dark chocolate and cool slightly. Whip 300ml cream and whisk 3 egg whites to soft peaks. Stir the yolks into the chocolate, then fold in cream and whites. Spoon into glasses, chill, top with crushed chocolate biscuits and a speckled chocolate egg.

d.note: the hot day at the park
d.how: Squeeze 6 lemons and dissolve 150g sugar in the juice with 500ml water. Freeze in a tray for 2 hours. Blitz with a few handfuls of ice until slushy and pour into big cups with straws. Perfect for a long queue in the heat.
